messages:
mira_cs: FYI renewal signal for AcmeRetail. Their embedding calls dropped ~70% overnight and they saw lots of "model_not_found" 404s. Possible blocker for next-week renewal review. Can eng confirm root cause? @raj_eng @tom_ops :thinking:

raj_eng: Got it — can you attach an example request/response and the time range? Also confirm if generation endpoints are fine or it's isolates to embeddings.

mira_cs: Only embeddings. Customer pasted this (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_cust_ABC123" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-2","input":"hello world"}'

# resp: {"error":"model_not_found","message":"model 'rwd-embed-2' not found"}
```
They saw the spike between 2024-12-02 03:00 - 2024-12-03 09:00 UTC. Their daily embed volume went 2.4k -> 680. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/acmeretail/embeds (customer_shared_view)

tom_ops: infra deploys: none in that window. Catalog updates: none. No platform incident.

deploy-bot: No serving or catalog deploys between 1802400000 and 1802469999.

raj_eng: Common cause: model id renamed in a client lib or a catalog refactor, or per-tenant routing rules dropped the alias. Did they upgrade any SDKs/wrappers?

mira_cs: They upgraded vendor wrapper to sdk-js v2.x last week. Release notes mention renaming rwd-embed-2 -> rwd-embed-v2. They claim they didn't change config, but wrapper might.

olivia_ps: Short-term mitigation: add a per-tenant alias for legacy model id so customer flow restores. Medium-term: global compatibility mapping for common legacy ids + clear deprecation email. Risk: we don't want indefinite aliases.

raj_eng: I'll create a routing override for acmeretail: map rwd-embed-2 -> rwd-embed-v2 and canary it in one region. ETA ~90m. Will monitor 5m error rate and embed success.

mira_cs: I'll tell the customer to retry in 2h and schedule a quick troubleshooting call. Also flag AE that renewal call might need sliding to avoid confusion. :calendar:

deploy-bot: Canary routing override pushed: routing/overrides/acmeretail/embeds -> {"rwd-embed-2":"rwd-embed-v2"}. Canary test: failing payload success rate improved from 12% -> 85%.

raj_eng: Canary stable. Rolling to prod with staged rollout and will keep alias for 30 days. I'll draft a migration note for customers using legacy ids and add monitoring alert for sudden drops tied to model_not_found.

mira_cs: Great work team — updating renewal playbook and AE. Scheduling post-rollout check-in. :thumbsup:
